Meta.title: AFA — Business process automation
Meta.description: AFA automates the repetitive work in your business: customer response, order capture, follow-up, and reporting.

Hero.subtitle: AFA automates the repetitive work in your business — answering customers, capturing orders, tracking status, and reporting — so your team's hours go to decisions rather than repetition.
Hero.ctaSecondary: See what it does for you

Service.title: A system that handles the daily work instead of your team
Service.body: We review your current processes, identify what repeats, and build a system that does that work without a person driving it. It runs on the channels your customers already use.

reply.title: Automated response
reply.body: Recurring customer questions — price, availability, delivery terms — are answered around the clock from your own information.

order.title: Order capture and tracking
order.body: Orders are recorded without manual coordination, and their status is traceable by the team in a single view.

followup.title: Follow-up and reminders
followup.body: Unanswered requests and past customers are followed up automatically, without anyone reviewing a list by hand.

report.title: Scheduled reporting
report.body: Performance reports are produced and sent automatically, so decisions rest on data.

time.title: Working hours returned
time.body: Work that repeats identically every day comes off your team, and the freed capacity goes to the actual job.

speed.title: Replies without delay
speed.body: Customers get an answer immediately, including outside business hours, so opportunities aren't lost to a slow reply.

consistency.title: Consistent and error-free
consistency.body: Answers and records are always the same and drawn from one source, removing human error and contradictory information.

visibility.title: A clear view of status
visibility.body: Order status and business performance are visible at any moment — no manual counting, no guesswork.

scale.title: Growth without more headcount
scale.body: More volume doesn't have to mean more hiring; the system runs the same process at a larger scale.

ownership.title: Full ownership
ownership.body: Source code, domain, hosting, and every credential belong to your organization. No part of the system stays dependent on us.

Work.title: What we've built for others
Work.subtitle: Three processes we automated that are running today.

restaurant.title: Orders arriving through three separate channels
restaurant.before: Orders came by phone, Instagram, and WhatsApp and were written on paper; during the rush, messages went unanswered.
restaurant.after: Response and order capture are automated, and every order's status is traceable by the kitchen and the till in one view.
restaurant.scope: Automated response · Order capture · Weekly reporting

retail.title: Sales running entirely through DMs
retail.before: Every order took several messages back and forth, and no customer record survived the sale.
retail.after: Catalog and payment moved online, recurring questions are answered automatically, and purchases land in a customer database.
retail.scope: Online store · Automated response · Customer database

services.title: Dispatch coordinated by hand
services.before: Requests were taken by phone and scheduled in a notebook; follow-ups were forgotten.
services.after: Requests are captured and scheduled automatically, with reminders sent to both the customer and the technician.

Work.note: Some names are withheld at the client's request.

Impact.title: See exactly what you get back
Impact.subtitle: Set four numbers to your own business to see an estimate of the result.

staff.label: How many people do repetitive work?

requests.label: Requests or orders received per month

missed.label: What share goes unanswered or unfollowed?

workdays.label: Working days returned to the team

Impact.disclaimer: This is an estimate from your own inputs, not a delivery commitment. It assumes roughly 60% of repetitive work is automatable and roughly 70% of missed requests are recoverable; the real figures follow a review of your processes.
Impact.ctaTitle: What are these numbers for your business?
Impact.ctaBody: In a short call we review your actual processes and give a closer estimate.
